question: How must the ritual jar be prepared with anointments and leaves?
premises: The jar has limbs anointed with white sandal
The jar is endowed with mango and aśvattha leaves
Both features qualify the same ritual object
inference: The ritual jar must be anointed with white sandal and furnished with mango and aśvattha leaves.
plain_english: Its body anointed with white sandal paste and furnished with mango and aśvattha leaves.
